lesson.grammar_point: past simple, regular and irregular, with did for the negative and the question

listenings.text: Good morning. Nora here. This is what happened last week, in one minute. On Monday the buyer in Rotterdam sent the first draft. I read it on Monday night. On Tuesday I called the client, and he did not like two clauses. On Wednesday we sent our version back. Then the ship arrived late, and we postponed the meeting for two days. Nobody called us. On Friday they answered, we agreed on a new date, and the client signed at four o'clock.

Eduardo, Tom Baker. I got back from Geneva yesterday. I want to tell you about the trip, because it changed the deal. I attended three meetings on Tuesday. The seller did not bring his lawyer, so we did not sign anything. On Wednesday I met the bank. They asked for two documents, and I filed them the same afternoon. On Thursday the seller called me. He accepted our price and our contract. We closed the deal on Thursday evening. I paid for the flight myself.
